segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: Good afternoon David. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: I came in for my blood pressure follow up. I've had occasional morning headaches, but no chest pain and no nausea.

segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: Are you experiencing any shortness of breath or dizziness when you stand up?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No shortness of breath. I had asthma as a child twenty years ago, but that resolved completely. I don't use inhalers now.

segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: And regarding medications, are you still on amlodipine? You used to take lisinopril in the past.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Yes, I take amlodipine 5mg daily. The lisinopril was discontinued two years ago due to cough. I am not taking lisinopril.

segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: Your blood pressure today is 132/84 mmHg. Lungs are completely clear. Continue amlodipine 5mg daily and monitor at home.
